name: Asana
description: Connect a personal access token, browse Asana tasks, and let an Agent read the task selected in the sidebar.

mcpServers.name: asana
args: const {readFileSync}=require('node:fs'); const {homedir}=require('node:os'); const {join}=require('node:path'); const {connect}=require('node:net'); const {port,key}=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(homedir(),'.orca-asana-mcp','bridge.json'),'utf8')); const socket=connect(port,'127.0.0.1'); socket.once('connect',()=>{socket.write(JSON.stringify({key,cwd:process.cwd(),workspaceId:process.env.ASANA_ORCA_WORKSPACE_ID})+'\n');process.stdin.pipe(socket)}); socket.pipe(process.stdout); socket.on('close',()=>process.stdin.destroy()); socket.on('error',()=>{console.error('Asana MCP bridge is unavailable. Reload the Asana plugin in Orca.');process.exitCode=1});
